content: Written 2026-10-07 23:40. Real row 4 = S3 + layer defaults (centre evidence, closed-state background) + the gated truncation-band evidence (--band-evidence, form 3c2a53d), code a39c143 (DN code present, flag off). Stage A only + eval, gate A >= 92.71 (user's relaxed targets relayed by the supervisor 23:3x: A 92.71 / B 93.11 / C 94.83, i.e. the original 93.21 / 93.61 / 95.33 minus 0.5); then stop, no automatic B. --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --band-evidence --dataset real --sessions a, GAME_CONFIG=flat.yaml.

As records/prerun_review_real_row4s3re2_3582aed_20261007.csv items 1, 10: KinectFusion (Newcombe et al., ISMAR 2011) Eq. 9, a reading writes 'inside' up to mu behind the measured surface; eligibility as the fork session_refusion.cpp:1272 (only elements this session has neither hit nor seen through). Purpose of the line (supervisor 23:3x): the map must follow reality -- the TSDF's band carves surfaces within mu behind a measured one, the layer lacked that step; this gate is A's G1, the map-vs-reality reading is the old-site table.
mu = LayerConfig.truncation 0.15 m (the TSDF runs' active-window truncation); no new constant.
eval_row.sh unchanged; G1 = official median export.

Offline replay on the S3cb B map (analysis/band_replay_s3cb.json): 140,906 band ends, official G1 of that map without them 91.00/93.84/92.40 vs 92.42 (neutral). Old-site reading 23:4x (analysis/old_site_elements_row4_B.json, trace_residue_row4_B.json): of the Gaussians alive on the 10 B old surfaces, ~30.8k lie 5-10 cm behind a current B surface (occluded verdicts, reading 6-20 cm in front) and 401 are > 10 cm from every current surface; the band rule addresses the first class.
A ~50 min + eval ~5 min (A took 49 min before); GPU idle (synthetic B stopped 23:28).

Gate A G1 F1 >= 92.71 (pass -> the A checkpoint serves the B runs; fail -> back to S3cb's A). Also read: alive Gaussians on old surfaces not applicable in A (no change); A's G1 within 0.1 of v7's 93.31 expected if the band ends are occluded layers only.

(a) the normalised expected depth E = U/A (2DGS Eq. 18) and the median M (Eq. 19) are different quantities: 'after normalisation it is the quantity the export reads' is withdrawn. (b) M - d = (M - E) + (E - U) + (U - d), E - U = U (1/A - 1); M - d ~ d (1/A - 1) only when U ~ d and M ~ E, both to be measured; the earlier '4.4 cm from not normalising' is a decomposition in a subset, not a proof of the training cause. (c) counter-example: two layers of weight 0.4 / 0.6 at 9 cm in front / 6 cm behind the reading give the right expected depth and a median 6 cm deep. (d) only the depth definition (Eq. 18) is sourced in 2DGS; replacing GaME's measured-depth term by D/alpha was our design. (e) DN2 full arm alpha<0.9 rose 0.14 % -> 1.42 %; A-stage DN 2.03 % vs v7 0.26 %; the 23:14 claim 'nearer errors lowered A's G1' is withdrawn (fixing only nearer pixels gains 0.00 in the upper bound).

Run stopped 23:42 after 1 min. The rationale (band set covers 76.7 % of 28,089 old-site residue Gaussians) is withdrawn: the strict count (alive on the old surface, > 10 cm from the B reference and from all 17 B object states) is ~300 (supervisor 299, mine 401); the gated band set covers 168 of them, the rest of the 28k are current surfaces 5-9 cm off and the 5-10 cm layers behind current surfaces. Band evidence stays a closed switch; final form = S3 + layer defaults (29d7f6e).
